resources.name: ContactPreference
resources.doc:
Effective-dated contact preferences; purpose-scoped so a cached "current
preference" is only ever disclosed through the caller's surface (PAR-143).

resources.name: Customer
resources.doc: Acme is the tenant. A Customer is an organization, not automatically a person.

caches.name: CurrentPreference
caches.doc: The preference in force for a contact right now.
